messages:
Anna (oncall): Paging reminder — seeing a spike in 5xx + tail latency for generation in eu-west-1 since ~08:12 UTC. Impact: some customers on Dedicated pools and Hosted EU endpoints reporting failed tokens and timeouts. Starting live mitigation now, opening a comms thread for statuspage + customer notes.

Incident Bot: [ALERT] Increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (eu-west-1). Pager routed to Anna.

Mike SRE: On it. Initial hypothesis: KV cache thrash after a rolling config change on the ded pool. Verifying metrics (cache hit/miss, OOMs, queue length). Can we confirm percent of user requests failing vs overall?

Anna (oncall): Quick numbers from dashboards: ~4% of generation requests in eu-west are returning 5xx; error rate peaked at 12% for 3m window. P95 latency up from 220ms -> 1.2s.

Jess (PM): We need an initial statuspage message now: short + factual, avoid blaming infra until RCA. Suggest cadence: initial -> 30m update -> hourly until resolved. Add support note for direct-reach customers.

Emily (Support): FYI — two enterprise tenants (acme-inc, dataforge) have opened high-priority tickets. Please include them in targeted update once we have impact and ETA.

Mike SRE: Draft for status page (initial):

```
Investigating: increased error rate for text generation in EU region
Status: Investigating
Start time: 2026-03-17 08:12 UTC
Impact: Some customers may experience failed requests or elevated latency when using generation endpoints in eu-west-1.
Workaround: Retry requests; reducing concurrency or switching to a lower-capacity model can reduce errors.
Next update: in ~30 minutes or sooner.
```

Anna (oncall): I like that. Add note: "We are prioritizing Dedicated customers for mitigation" per contract SLA.

Jess (PM): I'll take publish on the status page once we have the final copy. Also recommend we create a short customer email template for the two enterprise tenants. Emily — can you draft that while we triage?

Emily (Support): Drafting now. Quick version to send to tenants when we have ETA.

Deploy Bot: Deploy 2026-03-17_08:05 by ci/cd — rolling config bump to inference pool (eu-west-1) completed at 08:06 UTC.

Mike SRE: That deploy correlates. We're rolling back the recent config flag on the ded pool for eu-west to previous stable (in progress). If rollback finishes cleanly, we expect error rate to drop within 2–4 minutes of caches warming.

Anna (oncall): Noted. Add brief internal note to status page to avoid duplicate troubleshooting instructions for customers. Keep public message simple.

Jess (PM): Publishing initial statuspage now (internal->public sequence): internal incident note -> status page initial -> thread pinned to incident channel. Will post when live.

Anna (oncall): ETA check?

Mike SRE: Rollback finished at 08:28 UTC. Early signs: error rate down to ~1.8%, p95 lat trending back. Continue to monitor for 10m.

Jess (PM): 08:31 UTC — published initial status page entry and linked internal ops note. :eyes:

Emily (Support): Sent targeted message to acme-inc + dataforge with current impact and that we're prioritizing them. They acknowledged.

Mike SRE: Monitoring shows steady improvement. We'll keep periodic updates. If errors stay <1% for 15m, propose resolved notice.

Anna (oncall): Agreed. Schedule update cadence: 08:45 (15m), then resolve if stable. Everyone add any customer-specific asks into this thread.

Jess (PM): Draft for resolved notice (post-check):

```
Resolved: generation errors in EU region
Status: Resolved
Start time: 2026-03-17 08:12 UTC
End time: 2026-03-17 08:47 UTC
Impact: A subset of customers experienced elevated error rates and latency for generation in eu-west-1. Root cause: a configuration change to the dedicated inference pool that increased cache churn.
Mitigation: Rolled back the config change and allowed caches to warm. Service restored to normal levels.
Next steps: Post-incident RCA will be published in the incidents repo within 72 hours and will include a long-term mitigation plan.
```

Mike SRE: Add line: "If you continue to see issues, please include full request IDs and timestamps in support ticket."

Emily (Support): I'll send resolved confirmation to the two tenants and include the request-ID ask.

Anna (oncall): Good work. Once we hit stable window, Jess — please publish resolved notice and link to the RCA when ready.

Jess (PM): Will do. Preparing RCA draft with timeline and config diff. Planning to post internal RCA by tomorrow and external summary on statuspage after legal review.

Anna (oncall): Closing loop — last observed error rate at 08:46 UTC is 0.3%, p95 latency 240ms. Marking incident as "monitoring" then resolved soon. :thumbsup:

Incident Bot: Incident 2026-03-17-33321 transitioned to MONITORING by Anna (oncall).

Deploy Bot: rollback-2026-03-17-08:28 completed successfully.

Mike SRE: Leaving a short checklist for publish/resolution (internal):
- Confirm error rate <1% for 15m
- Publish resolved statuspage copy (Jess)
- Update support threads and notify high-touch customers (Emily)
- Create RCA draft and attach logs/config diff (Mike)
- Follow-up postmortem meeting invite (Anna)

Anna (oncall): Thanks team. I'll schedule postmortem for tomorrow 10:00 UTC and tag action owners.

Jess (PM): Resolved notice queued and will publish after one final 15m check.

Emily (Support): Closing the high-priority tickets once customers confirm recovery.

Mike SRE: Leaving monitoring dashboards open for 1h. Will post link to logs in the RCA.

Anna (oncall): Thread complete for now — will re-open if regression. Good job. :white_check_mark:
